test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"adopt"** is used here to mean taking up or starting something new in one's life, in this case, a healthy lifestyle.
 
• The word **"adeptly" **means skillfully, which does not fit the context of starting a healthy lifestyle.
 
• The word **"adapt" **means to adjust or modify something, which is not the intent in this context.
 
• The word** "adept"** is an adjective meaning very skilled, which does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
